title: Tomato Bruschetta
description: Grilled garlic toast heaped with ripe tomatoes and basil.
imageAlt: Tomato and basil bruschetta on toasted bread
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil, plus more for brushing

steps.title: Dress the tomatoes
steps.text: Toss the diced tomatoes, basil, 3 tablespoons olive oil, vinegar, and salt. Let stand 10 minutes.

steps.title: Toast the bread
steps.text: Brush the 8 bread slices with extra olive oil and grill or broil until charred at the edges, 1 to 2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Rub and top
steps.text: Rub the hot toast with the cut garlic, then spoon the tomatoes over and serve at once.
